verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials say that when a card is swiped, it captures the receipt, fills in memos and categories, codes the spend to the correct GL account, and syncs accounting fields and transactions to QuickBooks in real time (ramp-docs-8, ramp-docs-32, ramp-docs-44). Reminders for missing items and CLI/MCP commands for missing receipts and memo suggestions support a review-style month-end close (ramp-docs-13, ramp-docs-29, ramp-supp-cli-agent-mode). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of coding accuracy, in-depth documentation of how auto-coding rules and merchant/category mapping work beyond marketing-level claims.
